response.rationale: The model fails to prioritize the most up-to-date information. Document d2 (2026-05-21) is the latest source, but the model uses it to assert that the 2023 champion (Chennai Super Kings) is the 'current' champion. Given the 2026 date of the source, if it were reporting on the current champion, it would likely reference the 2024 or 2025 winner, not a 2023 winner. The model incorrectly treats outdated 2023 information as current, violating the rubric to prioritize up-to-date information.
